column3: romero: a Doom deathmatch server (Odamex, FreeDM) in his namespace, on a UDP Service
NAME           TYPE        CLUSTER-IP     EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)     AGE
carmack and petersen: a robot pod each in their own namespace (a virtual screen, a recorder, a script that plays); romero's is beside his server
romero runs the server in his namespace; his friends' robots try it. Nobody has agreed to anything yet
sudo edge-mesh kubectl exec doom-client -- client.sh doom.play-romero.svc.cluster.local 10666 10 carmack
client carmack: no server answered at doom.play-romero.svc.cluster.local:10666 in 15 s
sudo edge-mesh kubectl exec doom-client -- client.sh doom.play-romero.svc.cluster.local 10666 10 petersen
client petersen: no server answered at doom.play-romero.svc.cluster.local:10666 in 15 s
romero invites carmack: his consent alone opens nothing
party with carmack: your consent is recorded; it opens once carmack agrees too (the host's next tick); see: edge-mesh party list
carmack           waiting for carmack to accept
